youtube_title: Tyre Burst at Speed: Slam the Brakes or Hold the Steering? Brave vs Normal #23 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL #23. A tyre bursts on the highway. Brave slams the brakes, Normal grips the wheel and eases off. Who's right? Comment B or N!
Answer: Normal. Hard braking after a blowout can make the car spin or even roll. Grip the wheel with both hands, keep it straight, ease off the accelerator, let the speed drop, then brake gently, hazard lights on, stop on the side. Check tyre pressure regularly.
Source: Michelin tyre blowout advice; South Australia Department for Infrastructure and Transport.
